const int N = 300010;
int P;

    for (; b; b >>= 1, a = a * a % P)

    return c;

    for (int i = n-1; i >= 0; --i) ifac[i] = (ll)ifac[i+1] * (i+1) % P;

void sub(int &x, int y) { x -= y; if (x < 0) x += P; }

    for (int l = 1; l < n; l <<= 1)
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i += l << 1)

                add(f[i+j+l], f[i+j]);
